name: codex-project-flow
description: Install a reusable Codex workflow and create or recover one reopened, pinned project hub per local project.

interface.shortDescription: Create, recover, reopen, and pin a permanent project hub.
interface.longDescription: Adds a one-step bootstrap skill that installs project-flow templates, creates or recovers the permanent hub, reopens it, and pins it in the sidebar.
defaultPrompt: Use $bootstrap-project-flow directly in this saved local project to create, recover, reopen, and pin its permanent hub.
